name: Chalkline
summary: A teacher's dashboard: the school day on a chalkboard, classes, marking, grades and registers
about: An eight-page dashboard that puts a teacher's whole day in one place. The current lesson is written on a chalkboard with a live bell countdown, and there are class cards, a student list, a drag-and-drop assignment board, an editable gradebook, a tap-to-mark register and a week planner. Good for schools, tutoring centres and education apps.
how: Open Today: the chalkboard writes out the current or next lesson and the bell counts down in the header
Tick, add or delete to-dos and mark a submitted pile as graded
Drag assignment cards from Draft to Graded, or use the arrow button for a Move to… menu
Type scores in the Gradebook; row and class averages, letter grades and both charts update as you type
Take the register with P, L or A for each student, save it and switch the trend between 7D and 30D
Drag lessons between planner slots or from the ideas tray, or click one to edit and move it
Edit your profile and sticky note, switch notebook or chalkboard theme and reset the demo data
